_comment: Vortex full-system example (BloFin): wave-queue, gridspan-normalized sizing, gridspan-drift auto-reset, and dynamic spacing. Copy to .local.json, fill in credentials, restart the bot.
_note: BloFin variant. BloFin fees: maker 2bps, taker 6bps (minimum_tp tuned to 0.2% to cover fees). round_min_qty_blofin enabled (BloFin API requires explicit min-qty rounding).

vortex_dca._math: wallet_exposure caps total position notional (e.g. 70 = $70 on a $100 wallet).
vortex_dca._comment_grid_mode: === ORDERBOOK-ANCHORED GRID === Levels are placed at real bid/ask walls instead of fixed-pct spacings. Falls back to LINEAR if the book is too thin to bin nr_clusters walls in band.
vortex_dca._comment_gridspan_sizing: === GRIDSPAN-NORMALIZED SIZING WITH AUTO-DRIFT RESET === Quantities scale with live outer_distance / reference_outer_distance, clamped between min_scale and max_scale. sizing_drift_reset rebuilds the stored plan when stored notional cost vs current target diverges past the threshold.
vortex_dca._comment_gridspan_scale_cap: scale_cap=false: quantities still scale with volatility while the cap stays at the wallet_exposure-derived ceiling, so existing positions don't retroactively appear over-cap when volatility calms. Set to true to scale both paths.
vortex_dca._comment_wave_queue: === WAVE-QUEUE LAZY MULTI-WAVE ACTIVATION === When the first wave's grid is exhausted, the wave-queue lazily activates the next wave at current_price + current outer_distance with fresh scaled quantities. max_waves bounds the number of waves; wave_share allocates budget across waves (sums to 1.0); max_total_exposure_pct sets the hard cap relative to the soft cap. Subsumes the legacy extend_grid_when_exhausted and deep_rescue_extension paths when enabled.
vortex_dca._comment_dynamic: === DYNAMIC SPACING === Live outer_distance scales with vol_pctl (hybrid source: max of spread/price_range/atrp/tick_vol). Clamped to [min_outer_distance, max_outer_distance]. Floor 0.012 (1.2%) allows grid to compress in calm BloFin markets.
vortex_dca._comment_reactive: === REACTIVE SPACING === Stack-multiplier on top of dynamic outer_distance when book conditions deteriorate. Up to 1.8x widening on depth drops, spread spikes, or imbalance.
vortex_dca._comment_tp: === TAKE PROFIT: 0.2% (BloFin maker 2bps + taker 6bps = wider than bybit's 0.18% target) ===
vortex_dca._comment_stoploss: === MAX DRAWDOWN STOP LOSS — final backstop independent of wave-queue cap math ===
vortex_dca._comment_position: === PERSISTENT PLAN === Plan stickiness with auto-drift-reset. Legacy extension paths (extend_grid_when_exhausted, deep_rescue_extension) are explicitly DISABLED because wave_queue.enabled=true takes precedence — disabling here avoids the coexistence boot warning.
vortex_dca._comment_deep_rescue_disabled: deep_rescue_extension disabled — its job is now done by the final wave in wave_queue.
vortex_dca._comment_lock: Direction lock: refresh_lock_lower / refresh_lock_higher control whether the grid refreshes as price moves against the position.
vortex_dca._comment_misc: === MISCELLANEOUS (BloFin-specific: round_min_qty enabled — BloFin API requires explicit qty rounding to symbol lot step) ===
vortex_dca._comment_entry_filter: === ENTRY FILTER === When flat on a side, soft-block fresh grid placement if price is on the wrong side of a recent candle (long blocks if price <= recent low; short blocks if price >= recent high). Spike block skips both sides on wide-range candles. Applies ONLY to fresh-entry grid placement.
vortex_dca._comment_staged: === STAGED INITIAL ENTRY === When flat, place ONLY level 1 of the normal grid (smallest geometric qty, closest to mid). Level 1 PRICE anchored at strongest orderbook wall within band. Plan retains all N levels. After L1 fills -> rebalanced grid places L2..N.
